RFC5443-2-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21. The show-path helper tags in ldp_sync_test.go are gone. OSPFv2: originated Router-LSA decoded, not synchronized and hold-down give the max cost, synchronized gives the configured 100 (records applyLDPSyncOverride). OSPFv3: rfc5443_origination_v6_test.go, the same on the OSPFv3 Router-LSA (records v6RouterLSABody).

RFC5443-2-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21. Every tag reads the originated LSA. OSPFv2: literal 0xFFFF before session-up and in hold-down; a configured 0xFFFE reads 0xFFFF until synchronized, then 0xFFFE (records routerLinks). OSPFv3: TestRFC5443V6NotOperationalLinkAdvertisedAtMaxCost reads 0xFFFF; TestRFC5443V6OperationalLinkAdvertisedAtConfiguredCost tells 0xFFFE from 0xFFFF (records v6RouterLSABody). The effectiveP2PCost show-path tags are gone.

RFC5443-2-5.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21; the units are unchanged by the edits to ldp_sync_test.go. Established: SessionUp only after the peer KeepAlive, naming eth0 and LDP Identifier 10.0.0.2:0 (records handleInit, keepaliveReceived). Bindings exchanged, by the hold-down estimate: session-up alone leaves the link costed out, Synchronized only on hold-down expiry (records onSessionUp, onHoldDownExpiry).

RFC5443-3-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21. The TestLDPSyncTECostUntouched tags, which no input could make tell per-peer from whole-link, are gone. TestRFC5443BroadcastCostOutCoversWholeSegment: two Full peers, the originated Router-LSA has 0 transit and 0 per-peer links while not synchronized, exactly 1 transit link and 0 per-peer once synchronized. TestRFC5443BroadcastOnePeerUpKeepsSegmentCostedOut: one session up in hold-down still gives 0 and 0. Records on applyLDPSyncOverride.

RFC5443-4-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. Level: RFC 5443 section 4 reads lowercase 'should only be applied to the IP link cost'; under D-3 a lowercase keyword keeps the row's MUST level, so no correction is owed. TestRFC5443CostOutRaisesIPCostNotDefaultTEMetric originates both LSAs from one not-synchronized snapshot: the Router-LSA link is 0xFFFF and the TE Link LSA (teOriginateType1, decoded) keeps the TE metric defaulted from the configured IP cost, 100. TestRFC5443CostOutLeavesExplicitTEMetric covers the explicit te-metric branch (50 unchanged). Both branches of applyTELinkAttributes are covered and a TE metric raised by the cost-out goes red. The false 'Ze originates no TE LSA' tags were removed from TestLDPSyncTECostUntouched.
